name: Heighten Spellcraft empowers the champion by 3
notes: Heighten Spellcraft's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 1-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window. Empower(player, 3, cardID) tags the champion's TurnEffects with the source card ID, EMPOWERED, and EMPOWER_PLUS_3 (the effective +3 level applied to the next Spell activated this turn is not independently observable without also activating a Spell, so this fixture covers the Empower application itself).
